summary: Frontend Systems Engineer with 3+ years experience building zero-JS baseline architectures, high-performance web applications, and accessible design systems. Proven track record achieving sub-50ms TTFB, 0.00 CLS, and 100/100 Lighthouse performance metrics across production platforms.

highlights: Architected static-first web platforms for 6+ client systems using Astro 7, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS v4, delivering sub-50ms global TTFB and strict 0.00 Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS).
Engineered component design systems with daisyUI 5 and OKLCH color palettes, cutting client bundle payloads by 65% and attaining 100/100 Lighthouse benchmarks across mobile viewports.
Constructed automated pre-flight quality enforcement hooks in Node.js to validate link integrity, metadata parity, and image layout bounds prior to static artifact generation.
Engineered responsive UI architectures using Tailwind CSS, React, and Twig templating for an AI-integrated recruitment platform, cutting initial render times by 40%.
Delivered pixel-perfect mobile-first components with WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility compliance and micro-interaction states.
Developed high-concurrency client interfaces and checkout flows integrated with Hono proxy gateways, handling 15K daily transactions with sub-800ms Largest Contentful Paint (LCP).
Instrumented real-time Sentry frontend telemetry and exception monitoring, triaging UI race conditions and reducing customer-facing checkout errors by 14%.
Authored comprehensive Playwright end-to-end regression suites integrated into CI pipelines, eliminating cross-browser layout discrepancies across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit.
Implemented WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards and responsive grid refactors across legacy web portals, increasing mobile user engagement by 40%.
